### A plain definition

Whatever brought you here, the label settles it. The other single jars on this page are 0% chicory.

## How do you read the chicory line on the jar?

When you pick up a jar of instant coffee at the local grocery store, turning it around to read the fine print on the back label can feel like deciphering a secret code. Most shoppers simply look at the brand name and the price tag, completely missing the small ingredient disclosure line tucked away near the bottom. That single line tells the entire truth about what is actually sitting in your kitchen cabinet. For instance, if you enjoy a traditional morning milk coffee, you might be used to a blend that includes chicory root added in. If you prefer a completely pure brew, our Bold pure coffee option contains zero chicory at all, giving you a strong, honest kick without any fillers. Reading that back label lets you know precisely what goes into your daily cup. Taking just five seconds to check the percentage breakdown on the jar ensures you always get the exact taste, strength, and blend you actually paid for, keeping your morning routine honest and transparent.
